description: This file defines messaging-related classes and templates within the Thunder::Core::Messaging namespace, including a template class for message categories, a TextMessage class implementing an event interface, and a macro for defining messaging categories.

classes.name: BaseCategoryType
classes.description: A template class representing a category type with associated text data, supporting formatting and data retrieval.

classes.name: TextMessage
classes.description: A class implementing the IEvent interface, representing a text message with serialization and deserialization capabilities.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the TextMessage into a buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a buffer into the TextMessage.
